items.title: 4.2 Badalti (variable) force ka kiya kaam (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 4.2 with Figs. 4.5 to 4.8 and Example 4.1 (PDF 76-78).

blocks.text: Bohat si soorton mein kaam karne ke doran force mustaqil nahi rehti. Maslan, jaise rocket Zameen se door jata hai, gravity ki force ke khilaf kaam hota hai, jo Zameen ke markaz se faasle ke muraba ke ulat badalti hai; isi tarah spring ki lagai force kheench ki miqdar ke saath barhti hai. Aisi soorton mein kiya kaam kaise nikalein?

Fig. 4.5 xy-plane mein zarre ka rasta dikhati hai jab woh nuqte P se nuqte Q tak chalta hai. Rasta displacements delta d1, delta d2, ..., delta dn ke n chhote wuqfon mein bata hai, aur F1, F2, ..., Fn in wuqfon mein lagne wali forces hain. Har chhote wuqfe mein force taqreeban mustaqil mani jati hai, to pehle wuqfe ka kaam delta W1 = F1 . delta d1 = F1 cos theta1 delta d1 hai, aur doosre wuqfe mein delta W2 = F2 . delta d2 = F2 cos theta2 delta d2, aur isi tarah aage. Cheez ko hilane ka kul kaam in sab terms ko jama kar ke milta hai: W_total = delta W1 + delta W2 + ... + delta Wn = F1 cos theta1 delta d1 + F2 cos theta2 delta d2 + ... + Fn cos thetan delta dn, ya W_total = i = 1 se n tak F_i cos theta_i delta d_i ka majmooa ... (4.4).

blocks.alt: P se Q tak mura raasta chhote jamni displacement teeron delta d1, delta d2 waghera ki zanjeer. Pehle qadmon par neele force teer F1, F2, F3 thori mukhtalif simton mein. Note kehta hai har qadam delta W = F cos theta delta d deta hai aur kul kaam sab tukron ka majmua hai.
blocks.caption: P se Q tak raasta chhote hisson mein taqseem (Figure 4.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Ise graph se F cos theta ko d ke muqable bana kar jaancha ja sakta hai (Fig. 4.6), displacement d ko unhi n barabar wuqfon mein bant kar aur har wuqfe ke shuru mein F cos theta ki qeemat dikhai hui. i-wein rangeen mustateel ka raqba F_i cos theta_i delta d_i hai, i-wein wuqfe mein kiya kaam; to Eq. 4.4 ka diya kaam sab mustateelon ke raqbon ke majmooe ke barabar hai. Agar hum faasle ko itne zyada wuqfon mein bantein ke har delta d bohat chhota ho jaye to Eq. 4.4 ka kaam zyada durust hota hai, aur har delta d ko sifr ki taraf le jane par bilkul durust nateeja milta hai: W_total = had (delta d -> 0) i = 1 se n tak F_i cos theta_i delta d_i ke majmooe ki ... (4.5). Is had mein mustateelon ka kul raqba (Fig. 4.6) P se Q tak F cos theta ke muqable d curve aur x-axis ke darmiyan raqbe ki taraf jata hai (Fig. 4.7).

blocks.alt: P se Q tak displacement ke muqable mein F cos theta ka graph. Surkh curve oopar neeche jata hai; us ke neeche aath patle neele rectangles, har aik ki chaurai delta d aur area F cos theta guna delta d.
blocks.caption: Displacement ke muqable mein F cos theta, patle rectangles ki shakal mein (Figure 4.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Wahi graph, P aur Q ke darmiyan surkh F cos theta curve ke neeche poora hissa hara aur area = work W likha hai. Note kehta hai jab delta d bohat chhota ho to strips poora area bhar dete hain.
blocks.caption: Kaam: P se Q tak F cos theta curve ke neeche ka area (Figure 4.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Badalti force ka kaam
blocks.text: Zarre ko do nuqton ke darmiyan hilane mein badalti force ka kiya kaam do nuqton P aur Q ke darmiyan F cos theta ke muqable d curve ke neeche ke raqbe ke barabar hai (Fig. 4.7).

blocks.title: Example 4.1
blocks.text: Cheez par lagne wali force F faasle d ke saath Fig. 4.8 ki tarah badalti hai (d = 0 se d = 4 m tak 5 N, phir d = 6 m par seedhi lakeer mein sifr tak girti hui). Cheez ke d = 0 se d = 6 m tak chalne mein force ka kiya kaam nikalein. Hal: kiya kaam d = 0 se d = 6 m tak curve ke neeche ke kul raqbe ke barabar hai, jo d = 0 se d = 4 m tak mustateel hisse ke raqbe jama d = 4 m se d = 6 m tak triangle hisse ke raqbe ke barabar hai. Mustateel se zahir kaam = 4 m x 5 N = 20 N m = 20 J; triangle se zahir kaam = (1/2) x 2 m x 5 N = 5 N m = 5 J. Is liye kul kiya kaam = 20 J + 5 J = 25 J.

blocks.alt: Newton mein force aur metre mein displacement ka graph. Force 0 se 4 m tak 5 N hai (neela rectangle, area 5 N x 4 m = 20 J), phir seedhi lakeer mein 6 m par 0 ho jati hai (surkh tikon, area 5 J). Dabbe mein kul kaam = 25 J.
blocks.caption: Example 4.1 ke liye force aur displacement ka graph (Figure 4.8 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
Mustaqil ke muqable badalti force
rows: W = F_i cos theta_i delta d_i ke majmooe ki had
F cos theta ke muqable d curve ke neeche raqba

blocks.prompt: 0.5 kg mass ka jism seedhi lakeer mein velocity v = a y^(3/2) se chalta hai, a = 5 m^-1/2 s^-1. y = 0 se y = 5 m tak displacement ke doran khalis force ka kiya kaam nikalein (numerical problem 4.9).
blocks.explanation: Work-energy theorem se khalis force ka kaam kinetic energy ki tabdeeli ke barabar hai: y = 5 m par v = 5 x 5^(3/2) = 5 x 11.18 = 55.9 m s^-1 aur y = 0 par v = 0, to W = (1/2)(0.5)(55.9)^2 - 0 = 781.25 J, chhapa jawab. Yahan force jagah ke saath badalti hai, to seedha rasta force-displacement curve ke neeche ka raqba hota.

items: Badalti force (rocket par gravity, spring): rasta chhote wuqfon mein kaatein, W = majmooa F_i cos theta_i delta d_i; had delta d -> 0 mein kaam P aur Q ke darmiyan F cos theta ke muqable d curve ke neeche raqba hai. Example 4.1: 20 J + 5 J = 25 J.
